scope: Rules-based V2 critic for suction core energy only.

detection_rules: MainAttractionStreaks uses angular/vortex motion without a native inward attraction module.
MainAttractionStreaks relies on ribbon orbit silhouette instead of outside-to-core pull.
orbit_dominant.escalation_rule: If seen for two consecutive Layer A reviews, trigger rebuild_main_attraction_layer and block scalar-only Layer A polish.

detection_rules: MainAttractionStreaks is missing Point Attraction Force or equivalent inward pull.
MainAttractionStreaks spawns at or near the core instead of an outer zone.
no_outside_to_core_read.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hits force Layer A rebuild.

detection_rules: MainAttractionStreaks lifetime or force balance implies particles will fly through the core without merging or fading.
overshoot_through_core.escalation_rule: Escalate to rebuild only if still present after one retune and a fresh capture.

detection_rules: Vortex-oriented modules dominate Layer A/B more strongly than inward attraction.
angular_motion_too_high.escalation_rule: Reduce angular motion before touching layer count or brightness.

detection_rules: MainAttractionStreaks emitter is missing or under-authored.
Hero layer is not visually distinct from secondary support layers.
hero_sweep_missing.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hits force Layer A rebuild.

detection_rules: MainAttractionStreaks is authored primarily as a ribbon cage or ring shell.
Deterministic ribbons dominate the orb silhouette instead of reading as pulled-in energy mass.
cage_silhouette_risk.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hits force Layer A rebuild and preserve Layers C-E.

detection_rules: No hero attraction layer or hero material family is present.
hero_layer_missing.escalation_rule: Escalate to hero_sweep_missing if unresolved after one authoring pass.

detection_rules: SecondaryFilaments density, width, or motion competes with MainAttractionStreaks.
secondary_overwhelms_hero.escalation_rule: Reduce secondary support before modifying hero sweep.

detection_rules: CoreTurbulence, Sparks, or ShockGlow are missing and the orb lacks internal support mass.
support_fill_missing.escalation_rule: Fill missing support layers before polishing Layer A.

detection_rules: SecondaryFilaments or shell support uses torus/ring topology that dominates the orb read.
shell_ring_dominant.escalation_rule: Retune support distribution before touching hero intensity.

detection_rules: Layer overlap creates a closed ring/cage silhouette around the core.
Secondary ribbon support spawns from a sphere shell and is driven mostly by vortex motion without inward pull.
silhouette_too_closed.escalation_rule: Prefer support-layer spacing changes over adding brightness.

detection_rules: Hero streak material reads as graphic linework or wireframe instead of flame/plasma mass.
Main attraction layer is rendered with ribbon-first line bodies.
Secondary filament ribbons still contain Custom-HLSL or other non-native authoring residue that reinforces graphic line reads.
linework_not_flame_body.escalation_rule: Run simplify_hero_ribbon_material before any extra noise or bloom.

detection_rules: Opacity breakup dominates silhouette readability over the energy body mass.
opacity_noise_dominates.escalation_rule: Reduce opacity noise amplitude before adding extra layers.

detection_rules: CoreTurbulence or ShockGlow lacks a readable hot inner core.
inner_hot_core_missing.escalation_rule: Repair core merge glow before changing outer streaks.

detection_rules: Core or shell emissive overwhelms internal detail and silhouette read.
glow_bloom_dominates_detail.escalation_rule: Lower bloom dominance only after confirming the inner hot core still reads.
